snippet.title: Harbourlight - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Every night, the sign comes on. One guest walks in. You cook.

Harbourlight is a cozy farm-to-table diner sim set in a small harbour town. Grow your ingredients, fish the shoreline, forage what the seasons leave behind — then serve one person, one dish, one night at a time.

There's no recipe card telling you what to do. Every ingredient carries a taste — sweet, sour, bitter, salt, umami, heat, fat, aroma — and every guest has a palate of their own. Get it close and they'll tell you. Get it right and they'll tell you more.

🍜 ONE GUEST A NIGHT
The diner seats one. Cook for them, listen to them, and watch a life come apart and back together across the seasons.

🌱 GROW WHAT YOU SERVE
A working farm, seasonal crops, a fishing rod and a shoreline worth walking. Everything you cook with, you brought in yourself.

🔥 COOK BY TASTE
Eight taste pillars. No recipe list, no fail state — just ingredients, a pan, and a palate that sharpens the more you use it.

🌊 A TOWN THAT REMEMBERS
The carpenter. The fisherman. The nurse. Regulars whose stories only open up if you keep the light on for them.

⭐ WISHLIST ON STEAM

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4919050/Harbourlight/

Wishlists are the single biggest thing you can do to help a solo dev get seen. Thank you.

—

Made by one person, in Unity.
